# **Summary**
***

## **Synopsis**


In this case study, you've learned about why {{< glossary "version control" >}} is used as part of {{< glossary "reproducible" >}} science workflows. You've been introduced to {{< glossary "Git" >}} and {{< glossary "GitHub" >}}, and learned procedures for managing Git-tracked {{< glossary "repositories" >}} locally using {{< glossary "GitHub Desktop" >}} or the {{< glossary "command line" >}}, and remotely using GitHub. You've practiced using the "pull -> stage -> commit -> push" workflow to make changes locally that are then tracked remotely. In your analysis, you worked in a {{< glossary "branch" >}}, and you submitted a {{< glossary "pull request" >}} in order to integrate new changes into a stable version of the code and as a way to ask a collaborate to review your code. 

Along the way, you've also learned about the advantages and challenges of {{< glossary "meta-analyses" >}} and best practices for scientific project organization.

<!-- creates empty card bank, to be filled with shuffled cards -->
<div id="bank" class="bank"></div>

<!-- JavaScript part of code, creates interactive features -->
<!-- calls external library SortableJS to do drag-and-drop interaction -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.0/Sortable.min.js"></script>

<script>

// create cards, each with an id and a relative path to an image
const cards = [
  { id: "receive-files", img: "img/receive-files.png" },
  { id: "local-git", img: "img/local-git.png" },
  { id: "remote-github", img: "img/remote-github.png" },
  { id: "make-branch", img: "img/make-branch.png" },
  { id: "perform-analysis", img: "img/perform-analysis.png" },
  { id: "readme", img: "img/readme.png" },
  { id: "push-remote", img: "img/push-remote.png" },
  { id: "pull-request", img: "img/pull-request.png" }
];

// function to shuffle the cards when they are put into the card bank 
function shuffle(array) {
  for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
  }
}

// function to create card 
function createCard(card) {

  const div = document.createElement("div");

  div.className = "card";
  div.dataset.id = card.id;

  const img = document.createElement("img");

  img.src = card.img;
  img.alt = card.id;
  
  div.appendChild(img);

  return div;
}

// function to reset all elements, shuffle cards in bank and clear dropzones 
function setupBoard() {

  const bank = document.getElementById("bank");

  bank.innerHTML = "";

  document
    .querySelectorAll(".dropzone")
    .forEach(z => {
      z.innerHTML = "";
      z.classList.remove(
        "correct",
        "incorrect"
      );
    });

  const shuffled = [...cards];

  shuffle(shuffled);

  shuffled.forEach(card => {
    bank.appendChild(createCard(card));
  });

}

// initialize drag-and-drop 
window.addEventListener("load", function() {

  setupBoard();

  Sortable.create(
    document.getElementById("bank"),
    {
      group: "workflow",
      animation: 150
    }
  );

  document
    .querySelectorAll(".dropzone")
    .forEach(zone => {

      Sortable.create(zone, {
        group: "workflow",
        animation: 150,
        
        onAdd(event) {

          const zone = event.to;
      
          if (zone.children.length > 1) {
      
            document
              .getElementById("bank")
              .appendChild(zone.firstElementChild);
      
          }
        }
      });
    });
});

// event handler, to check all dropzones to see if correct or incorrect 
document
.getElementById("check-btn")
.addEventListener("click", () => {

  let correct = 0;

  const zones =
    document.querySelectorAll(".dropzone");

  zones.forEach(zone => {

    zone.classList.remove(
      "correct",
      "incorrect"
    );

    const card =
      zone.querySelector(".card");

    if(!card) {

      zone.classList.add("incorrect");
      return;

    }

    if(
      card.dataset.id ===
      zone.dataset.correct
    ) {

      correct++;
      zone.classList.add("correct");

    } else {

      zone.classList.add("incorrect");

    }

  });

  const feedback =
    document.getElementById("feedback");

  const total = cards.length;
  
  if (correct === total) {
    feedback.innerHTML = "<p class='pass'>Perfect! All " + total +
      " positions are correct.</p>";
  } else {
    feedback.innerHTML =
      "<p class='fail'>" + correct + "/" + total +
      " positions are correct. Continue adjusting the workflow.</p>";
  }

});

// event handler, to reset the board 
document
.getElementById("reset-btn")
.addEventListener("click", () => {

  document
    .getElementById("feedback")
    .innerHTML = "";

  setupBoard();

});

</script>

<!-- CSS part of code, controls layout and style -->
<style>

/* Set up workflow layout with grid */
.workflow-grid {

  display: grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    180px 40px 180px 40px 180px;

  gap: 16px;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  margin-bottom: 40px;
}

/* Set up dropzone appearance */
:root {
  --card-width: 180px;
  --card-height: 130px;
}
.dropzone {

  width: var(--card-width);
  height: var(--card-height);

  border: 3px dashed #bdbdbd;
  border-radius: 12px;

  background: #fafafa;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Create arrows */
.arrow {

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.top-down-arrow {
  transform: translateX(135px);
}

/* Set up layout of card bank */
.bank {

  display: grid;

  grid-template-columns:
    repeat(4, var(--card-width));

  gap: 12px;

  justify-content: center;

  margin-top: 20px;
}

/* Set up each card */
.card {

  width: var(--card-width);
  height: var(--card-height);

  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;

  background: transparent;

  overflow: hidden;

  cursor: grab;
}

/* Control how image will look within card */
.card img {

  width: 95%;
  height: 95%;

  object-fit: contain;
  
  display: block;
  margin: auto;
}

/* Style for correct boxes after checking */
.correct {

  border: 4px solid #26734d;
  background: #eef8f1;
}

/* Style for incorrect boxes after checking */
.incorrect {

  border: 4px solid #b22222;
  background: #fff0f0;
}

/* Style if all cards are in correct order */
.pass {

  color: #26734d;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
}

/* Style if some cards in incorrect order */
.fail {

  color: #b22222;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
}

/* Style for buttons to check answers and reset board */
button {

  padding: 10px 20px;
  margin-right: 10px;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

#feedback {

  margin-top: 20px;
}

</style>
